question: Does the P97 two-context failure associate with false context switches on stable worlds, or with failure to detect true returning contexts, on entirely fresh author-synthetic FIT/CAL cohorts?

hypotheses.H1_false_positive: If stable-world flip fraction > 0.20 in both CAL families, P97's thresholding has excessive false routing under stable causal dynamics.
hypotheses.H2_performance_association: Among stable-world CAL, flipped worlds have at least 1.25x the P97 final read-only query MSE of stable worlds that never flipped, in both families. An association not proof of causal mechanism.
hypotheses.H3_detection: At least 75% of true changed-worlds switch to the alternative context within 12 observations of B arrival (events 24:35) and return to original model within 12 observations of A return (events 48:59), both families.
hypotheses.H4_budget: Full 72-event P97 read+write and three held-out query operation has <=3x median CPU vs 256-float FIT-selected conventional baseline, benchmark on matched 8 worlds.
hypotheses.interpretation: Diagnostic: if H1+H2 hold both families, false routing is a plausible contributor, not proven cause; if not, prefer redesign of context signal/non-stationary update over retuning P97 CAL. All H1-H4 plus negatives needed for diagnostic target PASS, not SCIENTIFIC_PASS.

source.type: author-synthetic NEW seeded dyadic causal action-effect 16D source; no external simulator, no prior P97 FIT/CAL, no protected OOD

families.B: anisotropic coordinate-wise integer floor divide by 2**(j%4)

source.true_regime: Half changed A-B-A, half stable A-A-A, sorted by blinded deterministic hash; no labels passed to learner
source.probes: 3 fresh withheld actions after event 24,48,72, read-only; no ground-truth effect fed to model
source.independence: All four split seeds distinct from prior P97, P96 and protected unseen seeds; source byte fingerprints recorded for crossplatform reproducibility.

candidate.memory: 514 float32 predictive state + five integer control tensors
candidate.selection: FIT-only best all-probe MSE; early tie retains earliest; CAL scored exactly once per family, no after-CAL parameter choice
candidate.diagnostics: Step-by-step observed active route transitions without looking at regime flags inside model; evaluator has hidden switch labels only for scoring

controls.W256_SELECTION: FIT-only lowest three-probe MSE independently per family
controls.extra: zero, fixed W256 eta1 decay .99, wrong-time credit roll13, unconfirmed NaN masked no write, bitwise 24+24+24 restore
controls.capacity_matched: W256 256 float plus 258 inert values; disclose state+int control overhead
controls.compute: one CPU thread, median 7 runs after 2 warmups at batch8, entire original P97 episode vs W256 episode; diagnostic telemetry excluded from latency measurement
controls.protocol: No oracle regime flags used in model, no model first-use, no original Hybrid edits, no prior CAL data used in selection

qualification.tests: Source freeze hash, new source hash cross OS, unique worlds, no protected seeds; route segmented bitwise parity; confirm-only controls, wrong-credit, no oracle; present numeric DEV_FAIL or DEV_DIAGNOSTIC_PASS under frozen criteria
qualification.mandatory: Full exact candidate G4 Windows+Ubuntu and G5 Windows+Ubuntu and G7 Ubuntu CPU; no extra workflow/test-only dispatch
qualification.interpretation: Author-synthetic development only; actual unseen causal transfer, trained intelligence and RSI not established.
